body:
When a component is unmounted we remove its state from `searchState`, so if you need to keep track of the `page` cursor, you might want to save it somehow and add it to the `searchState` when mounting your `<ShowMoreResults/>` component.

I'm curious though about the behavior you put in place. If I understand correctly your `<AllResults/>` component is the combination of all your <Category/> components using each one its own `<InstantSearch/>` with its own index. But what is the configuration of the `<InstantSearch/>` used by your `<ShowMoreResults/>` component? Is there only one global button, or one per category?
